title: Dataset provenance and reproducible partitions
summary: Datasets and partitions are immutable semantic evidence with stable sample identity, parent/transform provenance and optionally journalled RNG state for reproducible shuffled splits.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Evidence-grade datasets carry explicit stable identity and provenance/digest.
Derived train/test/fold datasets retain parent identity, transform and role.
Partition membership is explicit evidence, never an invisible temporary slice.
A shuffled partition is only replayable when its RNG state is replayable.
procedure: Construct MLDataset with dataset id, provenance and sample ids when provenance matters.
Supply MLDeterministicRNG when shuffled partition replay matters.
Retain the split/fold object with downstream validation evidence.

provenance.claim: MLDatasetProvenance, dataset/sample identity and immutable subset derivation.
Explicit holdout/k-fold plans and deterministic RNG-backed partitioning.
Regression proves provenance inheritance and split replay from restored RNG state.
